message: 憧れは空へと託す

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, it's getting dark so early now!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just because your machine-gun chatter never stops, Nanaka」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When you think of autumn, it's the season for chatting, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「The season for appetite suits you way better, Nanaka」

name: Ria
message: 「Autumn really does have tons of delicious food, doesn't it~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whew! A shooting star!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, another one fell」

name: Ria
message: 「More and more of them have been falling lately~」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this also affected by that... Re-Crea thing?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what's gonna happen~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If anything's gonna happen, I hope it's something fun」

name: Ria
message: 「Just one thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「If it's just one thing, I actually know what's going to happen」

name: Synn
message: 「Just one thing... is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! Tell us, tell us!」

name: Ria
message: 「You see, when Re-Crea draws near...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When it draws near...?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord comes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hyoh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Senpai. What's with saying that all of a sudden...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's true~! I heard it was the exact same way during the last Re-Crea, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speaking of the Demon Lord... Right, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm... hmph?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wouldn't they just blow the whole world up with a bang?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't think anything like that would happen~\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right, Nanaka-chan. The Demon Lord is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, the Demon Lord is a hard pass. Well, unless they do something that actually gets me hyped up, then that's a different story」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll do my best」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A-Ah, no, no! Regardless of what happens, we in the Student Council have to work hard so we're ready for anything\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. That's what the Crusaders are for, after all」
She tries to put on a cheerful smile, yet Ria-senpai looks just a little bit lonely.

name: Nanaka
message: 「C'mon, Senpai, are you really that scared of the Demon Lord?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh!? N-No, it's not that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「At times like this, you know. Let's make a wish on a shooting star!」
Stars are raining down at even shorter intervals than when we were watching earlier.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right now it's an all-you-can-wish blowout sale!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wish for something fun to happen!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wish for things to just pass by without incident」
